title: AN APP EVERYONE NEEDS
body: I have spent the last 3 years trying out all the different habit tracking apps but was never satisfied. This app is literally everything I have been looking for and MORE! It has made my life more organized, less stressful and has made me much happier. It’s now my favourite app
author: mebdac

title: ADHD HEAVEN
body: Super cute colours that soothe my eyes, super simple layout and use. Not overwhelming or complicated. Focused and easy. Doesn’t feel like a chore to set up or use. I love it, my brain is happy.
author: taylorburron
